body:
The Study board wrapper still constructs and mutates Chessground directly, leaving it outside the shared board lifecycle. Render it through the public Board contract while keeping legality, promotion, hints, sounds, focus and keyboard policy in the application. Owner, position identity, revision, input modes, annotations and diagnostics map to the package interface.

Application tests now exercise the public Board and handle; package BUI-03/BUI-05 own renderer restoration and generation fencing, BUI-06/BUI-12 own detached drawing and drawing cancellation, and BUI-07 owns geometry invalidation. The seven named application suites pass (71 cases); package tests pass (53); Game Review/composition tests pass (25); browser typecheck passes. Real-browser held-drag, drawing, responsive geometry and owner-switch qualification remains pending, as does independent review. The controlled interaction inventory lists six cases; it was not executed.

## Summary by Sourcery

Adopt the shared Board contract for Study board rendering and strengthen lifecycle, annotation, and stale-input handling across application and package boundaries.

New Features:
- Render the Study chessboard through the shared public Board contract while retaining application-owned interaction policies.
- Allow drawing to remain enabled when piece movement is locked or read-only.

Bug Fixes:
- Preserve authoritative board state and prevent stale move or drawing callbacks across position, owner, and mode changes.
- Prevent renderer mutations from affecting published annotation state.

Enhancements:
- Move board lifecycle, input cancellation, generation fencing, annotation handling, and geometry responsibilities into the shared board package.
- Update application tests to exercise the public Board and handle instead of direct Chessground internals.

Documentation:
- Document the additional drawing-policy regression in the shared board regression inventory.

Tests:
- Add coverage for drawing while locked and stale drawing-event fencing.
- Update shared-board and application regression suites for the public Board integration.
